mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_attendance (employee_id, att_date, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{attDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{userId}, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), remark = VALUES(remark), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW(), deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.emp_no AS empNo, e.name AS employeeName, d.name AS deptName, IFNULL(SUM(a.status = 'NORMAL'), 0) AS normalDays, IFNULL(SUM(a.status = 'ABSENT'), 0) AS absentDays, IFNULL(SUM(a.status = 'LATE'), 0) AS lateDays, IFNULL(SUM(a.status = 'LEAVE'), 0) AS leaveDays, IFNULL(SUM(a.status = 'OVERTIME'), 0) AS overtimeDays, IFNULL(SUM(a.status IN ('NORMAL', 'LATE')), 0) AS attendedDays FROM hr_attendance a JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(a.att_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} GROUP BY e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, d.name ORDER BY e.emp_no

SELECT w.id, w.period, w.status, w.remark, w.create_time AS createTime, IFNULL(t.detail_count, 0) AS detailCount, IFNULL(t.total_amount, 0) AS totalAmount FROM hr_piece_wage w LEFT JOIN ( SELECT period_id, COUNT(*) AS detail_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM hr_piece_wage_detail WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY period_id ) t ON t.period_id = w.id WHERE w.deleted = 0 ORDER BY w.period DESC

SELECT pd.employee_id AS employeeId, e.emp_no AS empNo, e.name AS employeeName, COUNT(*) AS detailCount, IFNULL(SUM(pd.qty), 0) AS totalQty, IFNULL(SUM(pd.amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM hr_piece_wage_detail pd LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = pd.employee_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE pd.deleted = 0 AND pd.period_id = #{periodId} GROUP BY pd.employee_id, e.emp_no, e.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.emp_no AS empNo, e.name AS employeeName, d.name AS deptName, e.base_salary AS baseSalary, IFNULL(att.overtime_days, 0) AS overtimeDays, IFNULL(att.absent_days, 0) AS absentDays, IFNULL(pw.piece_amount, 0) AS pieceAmount FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT employee_id, SUM(status = 'OVERTIME') AS overtime_days, SUM(status = 'ABSENT') AS absent_days FROM hr_attendance WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(att_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} GROUP BY employee_id ) att ON att.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pd.employee_id, SUM(pd.amount) AS piece_amount FROM hr_piece_wage_detail pd JOIN hr_piece_wage w ON w.id = pd.period_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE pd.deleted = 0 AND w.period = #{month} GROUP BY pd.employee_id ) pw ON pw.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND (e.status = 'ON_JOB' OR att.employee_id IS NOT NULL OR pw.employee_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY e.emp_no
